summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 60 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI pauses UK data centre deal over energy costs and regulation
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New ‘LucidRook’ malware used in targeted attacks on NGOs, universities
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 44 articles published in the last 24 hours
